# Entities

This area groups every named real-world entity referenced in the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK) and RKKP corpus. It encompasses the complete ecosystem of atrial fibrillation care and quality assurance in Denmark, ranging from the biological markers, medical codes, and IT systems used to track patient data, to the hospitals, health authorities, and key personnel who govern clinical standards. By organizing these entities into distinct categories, the wiki maps the complex infrastructure of clinical interventions, pharmaceutical products, geographic benchmarks, and foundational databases that drive national cardiovascular quality reporting.

## Pages

- [[entities/biomarkers/index|Biomarkers]] — Biological markers like thyroid function tests evaluated within clinical pathways and national quality registries.
- [[entities/codes/index|Codes]] — Standardized medical coding systems, including ICD-10, ATC, and SKS codes, used to measure clinical quality and extract registry data.
- [[entities/databases/index|Databases]] — Foundational national databases and registries providing the civil, diagnostic, and procedural data infrastructure for healthcare quality assurance.
- [[entities/documents/index|Documents]] — Formal publications, annual quality evaluations, clinical guidelines, and scientific studies underpinning atrial fibrillation care.
- [[entities/drugs/index|Drugs]] — Pharmacological agents, specifically anticoagulants, tracked to measure treatment initiation and calculate national quality indicators.
- [[entities/groups/index|Groups]] — Collective entities like patient advocacy representatives and private specialist cardiologists influencing healthcare delivery and registry coverage.
- [[entities/locations/index|Locations]] — Geographic and administrative entities, from national baselines to specific municipalities and regions, used to stratify and benchmark clinical quality.
- [[entities/medical-interventions/index|Medical Interventions]] — Clinical and non-clinical actions, including structured patient education and pharmacotherapy, tracked to manage and treat atrial fibrillation.
- [[entities/organizations/index|Organizations]] — Institutional bodies, hospitals, health authorities, and professional societies that govern, deliver, and benchmark cardiovascular care in Denmark.
- [[entities/people/index|People]] — Individuals such as clinical leaders, data scientists, and patient representatives who govern and guide the national healthcare quality registries.
- [[entities/pharmaceuticals/index|Pharmaceuticals]] — Specific medication classes, like NSAIDs and antiplatelets, identified as risk factors for severe bleeding complications in anticoagulated patients.
- [[entities/products/index|Products]] — Commercial and technical products, focusing on anticoagulant medications and pharmacovigilance data comparing DOACs with traditional therapies.
- [[entities/standards/index|Standards]] — Authoritative classification systems and clinical guidelines that establish benchmarks for diagnosis, treatment, and quality measurement.
- [[entities/systems/index|Systems]] — Core software and IT pipelines, including health and laboratory information systems, that underpin the national healthcare data infrastructure.
- [[entities/websites/index|Websites]] — Digital portals and web-based resources operated by health authorities to publish quality indicators and medical guidelines.
